summary: WhatsApp gaps from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations scenes k-outage and k-window. A terminally failed assistant TURN (attempts exhausted, or a settled turn failed with an outage-class code such as STREAM_FAILED, FINALIZATION_FAILED or TURN_INTERRUPTED) now stages one fixed ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE notice (I can't reach your business data right now. Nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.) on the same inbox, at most once, and the inbox stays FAILED with its error code. Retries, budget, authority, workflow and bad-input outcomes are unchanged. A turn reply cancelled because the 24-hour window closed (MESSAGE_WINDOW_CLOSED) is still never resent; the binding's next staged turn reply is prefaced once per missed batch by a fixed REPLY_WINDOW_MISSED notice on response revision 0 of the same inbox, delivered before that reply. Both notices are text only with no app link; the design's Try again and quick-reply buttons are not implemented because notices have no button path. No schema change, local only, and no provider, OTP or deployment change.
noAssistantImpact: Channel transport notices only. No tool, prompt, capability declaration, model run, draft, write or authority changes; both notices are fixed strings rendered from the server-resolved scope and re-checked at delivery.

docs.note: apps/api/src/assistant/channel-turn.ts only dispatches the staged failure notice; no capability, procedure, role or rollout change.

evidence.result: 6 pass, 60 expects: outage-class codes map to ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE and budget, authority, workflow, bad-input and retry codes do not; both notices render without a link and the window preface without a scope label.

4 pass, 28 expects: exhausted attempts stage one revision-1 notice with no run or message and keep the inbox FAILED; an existing outbox row or changed authority stages none; settled STREAM_FAILED stages it while BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and BAD_REQUEST do not; a missed window reply stages one revision-0 preface only when no later inbox has an outbox row.
Database integration suite not run in this change; no local QA database was confirmed.
